goal: Prevent private broadcast connections from being observable through peer discouragement handling
Stop misbehaving peers from causing subnet disconnects of co-located private broadcast peers
agreement: Strong support for preventing private broadcast state changes from being observed externally (vasild)
Tested and approved for avoiding identity leaks from subnet disconnect behavior (danielabrozzoni)
Verified by testing regression coverage for shared address disconnection (ViniciusCestarii)
Support conditional on backporting cleanly to 32.x (instagibbs)

categories.name: p2p
why: P1 because normal discouragement breaks private broadcast privacy guarantees by leaking node identity
Prevents drops of operator-configured private connections when an unrelated peer on the subnet misbehaves
